[rsiai.net] is live: Opus down to 0.05x, GPT down to 0.07x, Fable down to 0.15x, first top-up doubled

We built an AI gateway: rsiai.net Mainly solving one thing: official APIs are too expensive.

  • Opus 5: 0.05x (5% of official)
  • Fable 5: 0.15x
  • GPT-5.6: 0.07x

Run an Agent task that used to cost $10, now around $0.5.

Launch event: first top-up doubled First recharge, whatever you put in, we match it. Top up $10, get $20 in credit. Top up $50, get $100. No model restrictions, while it lasts, no tricks.

AFF Refer someone who tops up, get 20% commission.

Who it's for

  • Those coding with Claude Code
  • Those running Agents / automation scripts
  • Those doing model evaluation or batch inference
  • Those who find official pricing too expensive and want better value

Payment supports USDT / credit card / Alipay.

👉 rsiai.net First top-up doubled, limited time.
